messages:
alice: Heads-up — noticed a spike in 413s for embeddings from a canary app. Preflight passed but runtime failed on certain shards. Anyone seen this pattern?
ben: Seen similar. Looks like preflight uses global estimator (bytes/dims), but runtime enforcement is per-shard capacity.
carol: Can you paste an example request shape?
alice: smallish batch: 12 items, mix of 768 & 1024 dims, total payload ~420KB. Preflight returned OK with estimated units 12. Runtime: 413 from shard-17.
dave: Ah — shard-level softlimits are lower because shard-17 got allocated smaller slot. Preflight doesn't account for shard fragmentation.
emma: Is this the new metric `embed.batch_density` on the dashboard? I noticed dense batches show lower unit estimate than expected.
ben: Yeah that metric is calculated preflight-only. It doesn't factor in shard slotization. UX bug: console shows "Estimated units: 12" which is misleading.
carol: Propose: preflight should call shard-aware estimator (cheap RPC to routing) when `X-Embed-Prefer-Accurate: true` header present. Fallback: conservative estimate if routing unavailable.
alice: Sounds reasonable. Impact: small perf cost for preflight but reduces 413 and support tickets.
dave: Implementation detail — routing service can expose `/internal/estimate?dims=...&bytes=...&tenant=...` and return per-shard decision: `allow|split|reject`. Example: 
```http
POST /internal/estimate
{ "dims": [768,1024,...], "bytes": 420000, "tenant": "acme" }
```
response: `{ "decision": "split", "suggested_split": 2 }`
emma: For console, we should change label from "Estimated units" -> "Preflight estimate (may vary by shard)" and show a tooltip linking to routing-aware estimate when available.
ben: Also want telemetry: tag preflight events with `routing_hit=true/false` and `routing_decision=allow|split|reject`. That will let us measure how often preflight and runtime disagree.
carol: Agreed. Add metric `embed.preflight_vs_runtime_mismatch` and an alert when mismatch rate > 0.5% over 1h for a tenant.
dave: Rollout plan: 1) add routing-aware estimator behind `enable_shard_estimate_v1` flag in Console; 2) enable for 10% of traffic for tenants with high error rates; 3) measure mismatch metric; 4) open rollout to 100%.
alice: +1. Also, consider a UI toggle per-tenant in Console for "prefer shard-aware preflight" to help support teams triage.
emma: I'll draft the Console UX copy. Small nit: update the API docs for preflight example to include header `X-Embed-Shape: dims=768,1024;count=12` so clients can choose to send more accurate shape hints.
ben: One more thought — for mixed-dim batches, runtime may split across shards unevenly. We should return a structured warning in response when a split happened: "split_detail": { "parts": 2, "reason": "shard_capacity" } so clients can implement client-side retry/split logic.
carol: Good idea. Make that opt-in via `X-Embed-Want-Split-Advice: true` to avoid bloating responses by default.
alice: Ok next actions: ben to add telemetry tags PR, dave to prototype routing estimator, emma to update Console text, carol to add API header docs. I'll open tickets. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
dev-bot: Ticket created: INF-4532 "Shard-aware preflight estimator" by alice. Assigned to dave.
ben: I'll also add a Grafana panel for `embed.preflight_vs_runtime_mismatch` and wire an alert.
emma: Putting a short note in #incidents for customer-facing comms if we flip the preflight behavior during rollout.
alice: Great — follow-up sync next Tue.
